name: sun-readme
prompt:
Write tools/host/sunshine/README.md for the files in this folder (given as context). Plain, short English for the owner of the PC.
Sections (each '## ' heading followed by a blank line), after a '# Sunshine on soucouyant (SUN-01)' title:
- Why: on 11 Oct an old keepalive restarted Sunshine 1,572 times with a dead Hyprland session's settings and hung the GPU. Now Sunshine is a user service of the live session: the login hook hands the session's variables to systemd and restarts the unit; the drop-in's ExecCondition skips any start without the live Wayland and Hyprland sockets, and StartLimitBurst caps restarts at 5 per 300 s.
- Files: one bullet each for sun-01.conf, kk-sunshine-session.sh, install.sh.
- Install: run `sh tools/host/sunshine/install.sh`, then in ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua replace the line `hl.exec_cmd("sleep 3 && sunshine")` with the line the installer prints, shown in a ```lua block exactly as: hl.exec_cmd("sleep 3 && $HOME/.local/bin/kk-sunshine-session.sh")
- Check: `systemctl --user status app-dev.lizardbyte.app.Sunshine.service` and `journalctl --user -u app-dev.lizardbyte.app.Sunshine.service` (no restart loop), after a log-out and after a reboot.
- Undo: delete the .d/sun-01.conf drop-in, move the .bak-sun01 file back, put the old hyprland.lua line back, run systemctl --user daemon-reload.
Keep prose lines under 120 characters. End with one newline. Output only the file.
